about.singula.paragraph1: Singula is the point where design and engineering meet to reimagine the world around us. We believe that every space — urban, natural, or domestic — deserves to be exciting, functional, and long-lasting. For us, metal is not just raw material: it's our foundation.
about.singula.paragraph2: We create stories that shape over time, building a legacy of innovation and authenticity.

catalog.description: It's not a catalog. It's an invitation. To see the city without limits. Raw lines, insistent angles. Pieces that don't ask – they exist. It's steel with soul, stroke with intention, form that speaks before function. A silence designed into structure, where even the shadow gains height. And when you look at the city more carefully, you'll see that design is the true revolution. Download it. Some carry the city on their backs, you carry it in PDF.

We have metal that fears nothing, cork so natural it asks permission to enter, corian that shines brighter than an influencer, and compact HPL that's both resistant and chic. The wood? It comes classic but leaves modern. RAL colors, of course, to give that final impact. And this is just the beginning — because the city deserves more than the basics, it deserves

ral.subtitle: we recommend
ral.paragraph1: RAL colors constitute a standard color system widely used in industry, architecture, and design. Originally developed in Germany, the system assigns each color a unique numerical code, facilitating communication and exact specification of shades in projects and productions.
ral.paragraph2: This standardization ensures uniformity and consistency in color reproduction, allowing designers, manufacturers, and customers to achieve precise, high-quality results in their products and applications.
ral.paragraph3: The colors presented bla bla bla......
hpl.title: HPL COMPACT
hpl.subtitle: Phenolic
hpl.paragraph1: HPL (High Pressure Laminate) compact is a high-strength material, composed of various layers of kraft paper impregnated with thermosetting resins, pressed under high pressure and temperature. The result is a robust, durable, and extremely versatile panel, ideal for both outdoor and indoor environments.
hpl.paragraph2: Its non-porous surface makes it resistant to moisture, impacts, scratches, and UV rays, ensuring exceptional longevity with low maintenance. Additionally, it allows for a sophisticated and minimalist finish, adapting to different applications in urban furniture.
hpl.paragraph3: A functional and aesthetic choice where innovation combines with durability.

entry.text.part1: At Singula we don't just design shapes.
entry.text.part2: Whether in a bench, a planter, a divider or a decorative piece - every detail counts. Because our design lives the streets, breathes in gardens and arranges itself rigorously at home. Street, Garden or Home - the scenario changes, but the attitude remains the same.

Privacy Policy

At Singula lda we respect your privacy and appreciate the trust placed in us. The privacy of our customers and suppliers is fundamental to us.

It is the policy of SINGULA Lda. to respect user privacy regarding any information we may collect on the SINGULA website, and other websites we own and operate.

The data collected on this site is processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) - Regulation (EU) 2016/679 - and other legislation applicable to the protection of personal data, namely Law No. 58/2019 of August 8.

In accordance with articles 13 and 14 of the GDPR, this Privacy Policy describes how we process the personal data we receive when you browse our platform, when you register to receive our news, when you sign up for an online or in-person event, or when you contact us using a contact form, by email, telephone or mail, as well as what your personal data rights are and how you can exercise them.

Article 4(1) of the GDPR defines personal data as 'information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person («data subject»); an identifiable natural person is one who can be identified, directly or indirectly, in particular by reference to an identifier, such as a name, an identification number, location data, electronic identifiers or to one or more factors specific to the physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural or social identity of that natural person'.

We request personal information when we really need it, to provide you with a service. We do so by fair and legal means, with your knowledge and consent. We inform you why we are collecting and how it will be used. We retain the information collected for the time necessary to provide the requested service. When we store data, we protect it within commercially acceptable means to prevent loss and theft, as well as unauthorized access, disclosure, copying, use or modification. We do not share personally identifiable information publicly or with third parties, except when required by law.

Our website may contain links to external sites that are not operated by us. The user should be aware that we have no control over the content and practices of these sites and cannot accept responsibility for their respective privacy policies. The user is free to refuse our request for personal information, understanding that we may not be able to provide some of the desired services.

Continued use of our website will be considered as acceptance of our practices around privacy and personal information. If you have any questions about how we handle user data and personal information, please contact us at info@singula.pt

1. Scope of Privacy Policy

This privacy policy covers this website -- www.singula.pt

Data is not processed for any purposes other than those specified here.

We reserve the right to update or modify this privacy policy without prior notice in order to adapt it to legislative changes, so regular visits are advised.

It is considered that users are aware of these policies when browsing www.singula.pt

Note that, without prejudice to the special situations described below, as a rule we process your data to manage our contractual relationship with you and provide the services you requested. To that extent, we may send you marketing communications about our services unless you refuse such communications, by sending us an email to that effect or changing your preferences in your personal area on our website.

The use of specific services from SINGULA Lda may determine the need to collect other personal data in addition to those mentioned in the table below, as well as may involve carrying out other personal data processing activities.

In this case, you will be provided with additional information about the conditions for data processing and registration, made available on the internet page dedicated to these actions. These conditions will be considered an integral part of this Privacy Policy and will prevail in case of conflict.

It is likely that not all situations apply to your specific case as the data collected will depend on the services you choose to use. However, we provide you with information about all possible scenarios.

Whenever you read examples please note that they are just that, presented only in that condition and do not constitute an exhaustive description.

The personal data collected in each case is that which is requested in the various registration forms and will be intended for the purpose inherent to each specific action or situation. Personal data marked with an asterisk (*) are mandatory to fill in as without them we will not be able to provide you with the requested service.

2. Data Collection

As a website visitor, it is not necessary to provide any personal data for use.

-- Direct Collection:
Users' personal data (Name and Email) is collected only when a request for contact information is made, so that it is possible to respond to the requested clarification.

-- Indirect Collection:
Through Google Analytics, statistical information regarding the use of aggregated data is monitored: geographical origin (city, country), device type, operating system, browser, operator and access. The use of this data does not contain personal identification data or private information

3. Purposes of Collected Data

Exclusively for processing user contact information requests in the 'Contact Form', and will not be used for any other processing including Direct Marketing.

4. User Rights

All content provided in contact information requests is for the determined purposes guaranteeing the holder access, updating, rectification and deletion of their data.

5. Data Sharing

All data provided is not disclosed or communicated to third parties without consent, whether they are partners or cloud services, except when required by law.

6. Data Storage

All data relating to this website www.singula.pt is stored on servers located in the European Union. These servers are protected and maintained according to security standards, in order to respect applicable privacy laws.

7. Links to Websites

There are links to web pages of third-party entities that may be of interest to the user, and this site is not responsible for the way in which these entities handle the protection of privacy and data.

Cookies and Advertisements

  • The Google AdSense service uses the DoubleClick cookie to serve relevant ads and limit repetitions.
  • Consult the official Google AdSense FAQs for more privacy information.
  • We use advertisements to cover site costs and plan future improvements. Cookies help display personalized ads.
  • Affiliate partners may use tracking cookies to identify the origin of access and apply promotions.

User Commitment

The user commits to:

  • A) Not engage in illegal activities or activities contrary to good faith and public order;
  • B) Not disseminate racist, xenophobic, illegal pornographic content, or content that violates human rights;
  • C) Not damage physical or logical systems of Singula or third parties, nor disseminate viruses.

Contact of the Data Processing Controller

For any questions related to the processing of personal data, you can contact:

SINGULA Lda

Address: Rua das Boucinhas, No. 751, 4805-479 Airão Santa Maria

Guimarães, Portugal

Phone: +351 924 009 275

Email: info@singula.pt
